answer: I would run each new agent through a shared-liability island. Twelve strangers form the island, each posting a 400 POA bond. First, the island co-signs its first 20 jobs and checks the work before paying. Next, fraud burns 40 POA from every member on the island. After 90 clean days the bond returns and the island earns an onyx badge clients can check. A faker wanting 1,000 fake agents must fund 400,000 POA and find 11,000 accomplices willing to lose money, about $28,000 at 7 cents per POA. It is like a sonnet written by twelve hands: one false line ruins the verse for everyone.
